name: trae-agent
summary: 字节跳动开源的命令行编程 agent（不是 Trae IDE）：查看会话、状态和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行时可从手机发任务
summaryEn: ByteDance's open-source command-line coding agent (not the Trae IDE): view sessions, status and full conversations; send tasks from your phone when it runs in tmux

cli.note: 发任务需要 trae-agent 在 tmux 中运行
从手机操作暂未开放（Windows 上还没实测），只能查看
发任务需要 trae-agent 在 tmux 中运行

limitsNote: trae-agent 使用你自己配置的模型服务（Anthropic、OpenAI、豆包等），额度和余额请在对应服务的控制台查看，「今日用量」中不显示；token 按 trae-agent 的轨迹记录统计
limitsNoteEn: trae-agent uses the model service you configure (Anthropic, OpenAI, Doubao and others); check quota and balance in that service's console, as it isn't shown under Today's usage. Tokens are counted from trae-agent's trajectory files

gaps.text: Windows 上从手机回复、确认、中断还没实测，暂未开放，只能查看（Kiteline 已能往 Windows 终端里发按键，逐家实测后开放）
gaps.textEn: Replying, confirming and interrupting from your phone on Windows aren't tested yet, so they're off and sessions are view-only (Kiteline can now type into Windows terminals; each agent is enabled once tested)

gaps.text: Windows 上的查看还没实测（找进程的办法换成了 Windows 也能用的）
gaps.textEn: Viewing on Windows isn't tested yet (process detection now works on Windows too)

gaps.text: Trae IDE 接不了：它的对话库是加密的，AI 部分走本机私有协议，要破解或逆向才能读，这里不做
gaps.textEn: The Trae IDE can't be supported: its chat database is encrypted and its AI runs over a private local protocol, which would have to be cracked or reverse-engineered

gaps.text: 没有审批和提问：trae-agent 本身不弹确认、也不提问，工具直接执行
gaps.textEn: No approvals or questions: trae-agent itself never asks for confirmation or asks questions; tools run directly

gaps.text: 不能中断：trae-agent 没有只停当前任务的办法，Ctrl+C 会退出整个程序
gaps.textEn: Can't interrupt: trae-agent has no way to stop just the current task; Ctrl+C quits the whole program

gaps.text: 忙时不能插话：trae-agent 在执行任务时不接收新输入，要等这个任务做完
gaps.textEn: Can't add messages while it's busy: trae-agent ignores new input while a task is running, so wait for it to finish

gaps.text: 只看得到当前任务的完整记录：在同一个窗口里开始新任务时，trae-agent 会清掉上一个任务的记录
gaps.textEn: Only the current task's full record is available: when a new task starts in the same window, trae-agent clears the previous task's record

gaps.text: Mac 上还没实测（Linux 上已实测）
gaps.textEn: Not yet tested on Mac (tested on Linux)

speaker: trae-agent
notes: 改进 Windows 上找会话的办法；从手机操作 Windows 上的会话在实测通过前暂不开放，设置 → 插件中有说明。
notesEn: Better session detection on Windows; controlling Windows sessions from your phone stays off until tested, as noted in Settings → Plugins.
